title: Overwater Rescue
description: B-roll: Two U.S. Air Force HH-60G Pave Hawk rescue helicopters assigned with the 355th Wing, Davis-Monthan, AFB, Arizona and two California Air National Guard, HC-130J Combat King II aircrafts assigned with the 129th Rescue Wing, Moffett ANGB, California takes off from Moffett Federal Airfield, California, August 28, 2020.  The aircrews along with members of the 131st Rescue Squadron, Guardian Angel pararescue team are conducting a joint rescue long-range overwater operation for an injured crewman on board a bulk container vessel off the coast of San Francisco. (U.S. Air National Guard video by Master Sgt. Ray Aquino)
